title: In a 2023 survey of instructional designers, corporate roles averaged US$87,384 and higher education US$68,474
subtitle: Average salary of US full-time employed instructional designers by sector, self-reported, survey run July to September 2023 (number of respondents in brackets)
notes: Self-selected respondents recruited mainly through LinkedIn and the author's own channels, so the sample may skew towards people active online and towards higher earners. Averages, not medians.
Managers were excluded. Small groups (fewer than 50 respondents) are less reliable.

sources.label: Devlin Peck, Instructional Designer Salary Report 2024 (survey data collected 2023)
